pr_body:
## Learning loop — market-data panel

Neither fitter cleared the guardrails — current weights hold. Valuation/quality weights are fitted on look-ahead-contaminated features — see contamination block before approving. Live reliability gate is NOT passed — the model is research-only. Merging still changes live verdicts.

Panel: **18159 rows** over 84 rebalance dates (2024-10-03 → 2026-07-09), 21-session forward excess vs the equal-weight basket. Purged walk-forward CV, 4 selection folds, 22-session embargo, holdout 2026-04-16 → 2026-07-09 (never seen by either fitter).

### Fitters

| fitter | sel. IC | base | folds won | holdout IC | holdout base | qualifies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| tilt | 0.0809 | 0.0809 | 3/4 | 0.126 | 0.1257 | False |
| cv | 0.0963 | 0.0809 | 3/4 | 0.0971 | 0.1257 | False |

### Weights

| factor | current | tilt | cv |
|---|---|---|---|
| valuation ⚠️ | 0.3 | 0.3023 | 0.2 |
| quality ⚠️ | 0.25 | 0.2503 | 0.4 |
| momentum | 0.25 | 0.2487 | 0.05 |
| risk | 0.2 | 0.1987 | 0.35 |

### ⚠️ Look-ahead

only 0.0% of panel rows have a point-in-time fundamentals read; the rest fall back to a snapshot that post-dates them, so valuation/quality weights are fitted on look-ahead-contaminated features and must NOT be read as out-of-sample evidence. Run scripts.snapshot_fundamentals daily — this share grows as history accumulates.

| factor | solo OOS IC | point-in-time |
|---|---|---|
| valuation | 0.0497 | **no** |
| quality | 0.0791 | **no** |
| momentum | 0.0024 | yes |
| risk | 0.0642 | yes |

Price-only reference (momentum + risk, fully point-in-time): **OOS IC 0.0314**.

### ⚠️ Live reliability gate not passed

`model_reliability()` reports **research_only** (failing: sample_size, independent_dates, directional_accuracy, positive_signed_edge, conviction_calibration, evidence_freshness). This proposal is fitted on historical market data, not on live graded calls — but merging it changes live verdicts all the same.

**Merging this PR is the human approval gate** — it writes `model_params.json`, which the decision layer reads on next run. Close without merging to reject.
